about: R27e (2026-10-20; D-SRC-42, D-SRC-50, D-SRC-51): every sentence of the no-write notice, verbatim, for one path. tests/Model.test.js holds Model.stateUnreadableNotice, stateUnreadableJournal and stateBlockedHeader to it, both ways (every reason here is the function's, every sentence the function's). The README and docs/UX-SOURCES.md quote these words.
